description: A <link rel=stylesheet> under the base directory is loaded, the @import inside it is followed, and the later <style> block wins at equal specificity. The https link is not fetched and the screen-only link is skipped. Authored here rather than ported: the reference engine loads no external stylesheet at all.
visual_assertions: The heading is dark blue with a rule under it, from the linked sheet.
The card has a pale blue background from the imported palette and a thin blue border from the linked sheet.
The render does not stall or fail on the https link, which is never fetched.
